{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ministry of State''' was an Ministry within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]]. Along with its subordinate organization, the [[Alliance Diplomatic Corps]], the Ministry of State handled all relations with non-Allied governments.
